question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate phrasal verb:

The deal fell through because the parties couldn't ________ on the terms.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. see eye to eye**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"see eye to eye"** means to agree with someone or share the same perspective or opinion. (सहमत होना)
 
 
• **Example:** Despite their differences, they finally saw eye to eye on the project proposal.
 
 
• In the given sentence, the deal did not succeed because the parties could not come to an agreement, which aligns with the meaning of "see eye to eye." (सहमति पर नहीं पहुंचे)
 
 
• **Example:** The manager and the team need to see eye to eye before making a decision.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. see eye to eye**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Take over** (संभालना या अधिग्रहण करना): To assume control or responsibility for something.
 
 
• **Example:** After the merger, the larger company took over the smaller one.
 
 
 
• **Put across** (व्यक्त करना): To communicate or express an idea effectively.
 
 
• **Example:** He struggled to put across his point during the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Carry on** (जारी रखना): To continue doing something.
 
 
• **Example:** She decided to carry on with her studies despite the challenges.
